_about: The campaign page (wehale.io/<route>, today /campaign/charge-your-current) (docs/recharge/README.md): one "get the app" page. Everything that changes before or at launch is here. CONFIDENTIAL until launch: the page is behind a server-side password (gate), noindex, out of the sitemap and linked from nowhere.
_about_route: The page's path (may have slashes), the one place it is set. The media stays under /recharge/ (public/recharge, also behind the gate); the old /recharge address redirects here (netlify.toml). the page, the sitemap exclusion, the noindex headers (written into dist/_headers at build) and the QR codes all follow it.

gate._about: The one flag. true = the server asks for the shared password (netlify/edge-functions/recharge-gate.ts, password in the Netlify variable RECHARGE_PASS, never in the repo): the page and its files are not sent without it. At launch set on to false. See docs/recharge/README.md.

session._about: The campaign session, which lives only in the WeHale app (Isak, 29 Sep: no web session on this page; the hook, owner of main 30 Sep: the ritual, 'Pour a Blackcurrant. Press play. Breathe with Philip.', experience first, then the offer). The page names it: title, narrator and minutes. slug tags the events. STAND-IN values (The Wake Up, Edvin) until the campaign session is recorded (Philip); then set narrator and minutes, and stand_in: false. The chip is off (the ritual line names Philip); session_line stays empty.
session.title: Charge Your Current

copy._about: All the page's words, in the order they show. {narrator} and {minutes} come from the session. The offer is decided (Isak, 29 Sep: the page says only the free month; the prices are chosen in the app): offer_1 exactly and the store line (trial); never "30 days", never "no card", no claims.
copy.title: Charge Your Current
copy.about: Guided breathing with Edvin and Philip, on iPhone and Android.
copy.line: Pour a Blackcurrant.|Press play.|Breathe with Philip.
copy.offer_1: Your first month of WeHale free.
copy.offer_how_desktop: Scan with your phone to claim it.
copy.made_with: A guided breathing session, made with {partner}. Seven minutes, just for you.
copy.trial: The free month is a trial through the App Store or Google Play, for new members where eligible.
copy.noscript: Turn on JavaScript to get the app link, or find WeHale in the App Store or Google Play.

hero._about: The target design (the flow review's Landing page): a full-bleed photo under a veil, the lockup on top, the words at the bottom, one white button. The photo is confidential, so like the ink media it is NOT in git: public/recharge/hero.webp (local copy: npm run media:local; production: the signed link in CAMPAIGN_MEDIA_HERO_URL). Without it the page keeps the ink ground. partner_name fills {partner} in made_with: set it to the partner's name when Isak says so (the repo is public).

copy_sv._about: Swedish version at <route>/sv. DRAFT for Isak's approval (16 Oct); it overrides the English words one by one, so anything missing here falls back to English. The partner code and the link are the same as in English.

partner_logo._about: One swappable file per ground: src (black, for a light ground; not used on the page today), src_dark (white, on the page's navy). The committed files are dashed PLACEHOLDERS. The partner's real logo (marked wip) is never committed: for local previews put it at local / local_dark (gitignored, public/recharge/*.local.*) and the build uses it; ask the lead before adding it to the repo. Sizes: the wordmark's cap height optically matches WeHale's (real logo trimmed, 26 px tall on an 18 px WeHale logo, one baseline).

code._about: The code rides in the OneLink's deep_link_value (the app applies it at sign-up: email, Apple, Google). Order: ?c=<CODE> on the URL, else by_channel[ch], else default. The server codes are live (the owner of main, 29 Sep); the app side ships in 2.7.9. The product-page code contains the partner's name, and this repo is public, so it is NOT here: it rides in their URLs as ?c= (the QR script reads them from a local file outside the repo, docs/recharge/README.md). Influencers: their own ?c= code.

inapp._about: A way out of other apps' own browsers (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook ...), which often do not pass a OneLink to the app or the store. Words picked by Isak 7 Oct, on. Set on to false to switch it off. ?inapp=1 on the address previews it in any browser. {app} is the app's name, {browser} Safari on an iPhone, Chrome on Android.
inapp.text: Opened inside {app}? For the best result, open this page in {browser}.

channel_by_medium._about: Partner UTM scheme (utm_source=salte&utm_medium=<...>&utm_campaign=charge-your-current): when a link has no ?ch=, the channel comes from utm_medium. Anything else (a creator's name) stays web. The code is unaffected.

onelink._about: AppsFlyer OneLink, template zcid (the same as /breathe). pid is a CONFIG CHOICE for the lead and the owner of main: the media source this campaign reports under in AppsFlyer.
onelink._about_creator_pid: PROPOSED media source for creator links that skip the page (docs/campaign/CREATOR-LINKS.md), so AppsFlyer and the funnel tell them from page customers (pid above). Isak/the measurement lead confirm the name.
